summary: Wrote a six-phase, two-layer implementation plan. Layer 1 adds an archive-aware base-mode Check 12 to validate-state.sh (next_project_number vs. max in use, unioning the sibling archive's archived/abandoned/completed arrays) and promotes the --deep-only project_number uniqueness check to base mode, making both blocking at verify-deploy gate 10. Layer 2 adds a mutex-scoped --allocate-into NAME primitive to state-write.sh that binds the counter inside the specs/.scope-lock critical section, refuses a stale counter, and refuses a transform that allocates without advancing the counter. Coverage lands in the two existing suites that own each subject, so no new script file and no manifest.json edit is needed; per-caller migration is deliberately excluded with the required dependency edges recorded.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase two-layer plan for allocation-staleness detection and mutex-scoped allocation; 8 hours, waves [[1,4],[2,5],[3],[6]].
